title: The Ra channelings and the Law of One
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of The Ra channelings and the Law of One, about 1980s at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: through the raw channelings that Bharich was involved in with Carla Rukert who published the raw material and the law of one.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher and interviewer who studies psychic phenomena, told podcast host Jesse Michels about the Ra material, messages said to come from a being called Ra through channeling, where a person speaks on behalf of a non-human source, in the 1980s. He says Carla Rueckert, who took part along with a person named Bharich, published them as The Ra Material and The Law of One. Followers treat them as a teaching from non-human intelligence about the nature of reality.
